classes.label: ActionAuthorisation
classes.description: A human or governed system activity that accepts, rejects or overrides a ServiceActionRecommendation before execution.

classes.label: ActionExecution
classes.description: The time-bounded execution of an authorised service action. It records what was actually done, by whom, where and with what completion status.

classes.label: ActiveContract
classes.description: A derived class: a Contract whose start date is in the past and end date is in the future. Ensures time-aware contractual reasoning.

classes.label: Asset
classes.description: A high-value physical asset that is the subject of a servitization contract. Grounded in iof:MaterialArtifact because an asset is an intentionally manufactured artefact.

classes.label: AvailabilityContract
classes.description: Guarantees asset availability (e.g., 95% uptime per quarter). Exemplified by Rolls-Royce Power-by-the-Hour.

classes.label: ComplianceCertificate
classes.description: A certificate attesting that an asset, component, or process complies with a regulatory or contractual standard (e.g., ISO 13849 safety certification, airworthiness directive).

classes.label: Component
classes.description: A replaceable sub-part of an asset with an identifiable failure mode. RUL estimation is performed at the component level because different components exhibit different degradation mechanisms.

classes.label: ConditionEvent
classes.description: A time-stamped event asserting a condition level on a component.

classes.label: ConditionIndicator
classes.description: A measurable quality of a component that indicates its condition (e.g., vibration amplitude, crack length). Bridge between raw observations and diagnostic assessment, per ISO 13374-1.

classes.label: Consumable
classes.description: A material consumed during a maintenance process (lubricants, sealants, calibration fluids) that is not a structural replacement.

classes.label: Contract
classes.description: A servitization contract governing an asset. Three subclasses capture Tukker's result-oriented PSS archetypes.

classes.label: ContractKPI
classes.description: A quantitative metric bound by a contract with target and threshold values. KPIs operationalise the contractual guarantee (e.g., availability >= 95%).

classes.label: CorrectiveMaintenance
classes.description: Maintenance carried out after fault recognition, intended to restore the item to a state in which it can perform its required function (EN 13306).

classes.label: CriticalFailureEvent
classes.description: A ConditionEvent where the condition indicator exceeds a critical threshold AND the affected asset is governed by an active contract. Defined by an OWL equivalentClass axiom.

classes.label: CustomerRole
classes.description: The role of the customer who receives the service outcome and pays the contractual fee.

classes.label: DegradationMechanism
classes.description: The physical mechanism through which a failure mode progresses (e.g., fatigue crack propagation, corrosion, wear).

classes.label: FailureMode
classes.description: An identified failure mechanism for a component, modelled as BFO Disposition because a failure mode is a potentiality that inheres in the component. Aligned with IEC 60812 FMEA.

classes.label: FeedbackUpdateRecord
classes.description: A provenance-bearing record stating whether post-action evidence confirms the expected effect and whether the model, threshold, policy or no element requires update.

classes.label: InspectionProcess
classes.description: A conformity evaluation by observation and judgement, accompanied as appropriate by measurement, testing or gauging (EN 13306).

classes.label: InterventionOutcomeAssessment
classes.description: An evaluation activity comparing post-action observations and KPI evidence with the pre-action state and expected intervention effect.

classes.label: KPISettlementProcess
classes.description: The process of computing and recording the KPI settlement for a billing period. Produces a SettlementRecord as prov:Entity.

classes.label: MaintenanceProcess
classes.description: Abstract superclass for maintenance activities, classified by strategy per EN 13306:2017.

classes.label: MaintenanceRecord
classes.description: A time-stamped record of a maintenance action performed on an asset or component. Links to the MaintenanceProcess that generated it via PROV-O provenance.

classes.label: MaintenanceTechnicianRole
classes.description: The role of the technician who performs maintenance actions on the asset.

classes.label: MonitoringCampaign
classes.description: A sustained period of condition monitoring on an asset (e.g., 30-day continuous vibration monitoring). Aligns with ISO 13374-1 data acquisition block.

classes.label: Obligation
classes.description: A contractual obligation specifying an action the service provider must perform (e.g., respond to Degraded state within 4 hours).

classes.label: OperatingEnvironment
classes.description: A measurable environmental condition at an operating site that affects asset degradation or performance (wind speed, temperature, humidity, salt-spray exposure).

classes.label: OperatingSite
classes.description: The physical location where an asset is deployed and operating (e.g., a wind farm, an airline hub).

classes.label: OperatorRole
classes.description: The role of the person or team operating the asset on a day-to-day basis, generating operational data.

classes.label: OutcomeBasedContract
classes.description: Guarantees a business outcome (e.g., energy yield in MWh). The most advanced servitization form.

classes.label: PenaltyClause
classes.description: A financial penalty defined for KPI underperformance (e.g., $5,000 per percentage point below availability threshold).

classes.label: PerformanceBasedContract
classes.description: Guarantees asset performance (e.g., thrust output, energy conversion efficiency). Exemplified by Performance-Based Logistics (PBL).

classes.label: PostActionObservation
classes.description: An observation collected after an ActionExecution to determine whether asset condition, service state or contractual performance changed as expected.

classes.label: PredictiveMaintenance
classes.description: Condition-based maintenance carried out following a forecast derived from analysis and evaluation of significant degradation parameters (EN 13306).

classes.label: PreventiveMaintenance
classes.description: Maintenance carried out at predetermined intervals or according to prescribed criteria, intended to reduce the probability of failure (EN 13306).

classes.label: RULEstimate
classes.description: A time-stamped remaining useful life prediction with percentile uncertainty quantification (p10, p50, p90). Captures epistemic uncertainty essential for risk-informed servitization decisions.

classes.label: SafetyEvent
classes.description: A condition event with safety implications requiring immediate action, regardless of contractual status.

classes.label: Sensor
classes.description: A physical sensing device deployed on a component to measure observable properties. Inherits from sosa:Sensor and is additionally aligned with bfo:MaterialEntity.

classes.label: ServiceActionRecommendation
classes.description: An advisory information object proposing a service action on the basis of condition, prognostic, contract and cost evidence. It is distinct from authorisation and physical execution.

classes.label: ServiceCenter
classes.description: A facility where maintenance and overhaul activities are performed, typically owned by the service provider.

classes.label: ServiceOffering
classes.description: A defined service in the manufacturer's catalogue (e.g., vibration-based condition monitoring, predictive blade replacement).

classes.label: ServiceProcess
classes.description: Abstract superclass for all intentional service activities in the servitization lifecycle.

classes.label: ServiceProviderRole
classes.description: The role of the OEM or service provider who bears the contractual risk and delivers the service outcome.

classes.label: ServiceState
classes.description: A discrete service-contract state that inheres in an asset: {Nominal, Watch, Degraded, MaintenanceDue, OutOfContract}. Modelled as BFO Role because the asset plays a different function in each state within the servitization relationship.

classes.label: ServiceStateTransition
classes.description: The process of transitioning an asset from one ServiceState to another (e.g., Nominal to Watch). Each transition has a specific time, causal antecedent, and authorising stakeholder.

classes.label: SettlementRecord
classes.description: A time-stamped record of a KPI settlement computation for a billing period, with full PROV-O provenance linking the settlement value to underlying sensor observations.

classes.label: SparePart
classes.description: A replacement component held in inventory for corrective or preventive maintenance. Linked to the component it replaces via sdt:isSpareFor and to a depot via sdt:storedAt.

classes.label: SparePartDepot
classes.description: A storage facility for spare parts and consumables.

classes.label: StakeholderRole
classes.description: Abstract superclass for all servitization stakeholder roles. Modelled as BFO Role because what matters is the role's responsibilities and authorisations.

classes.label: SupportingDocument
classes.description: A document that supports the servitization lifecycle — includes maintenance records, compliance certificates, inspection reports, and contractual annexes. Grounded in iof:InformationContentEntity because documents are information-bearing artefacts.

properties.label: affects
properties.description: Which component the condition event concerns.

properties.label: assessesExecution
properties.description: Links an outcome-assessment activity to the executed action being evaluated.

properties.label: authorisedBy
properties.description: Links a ServiceStateTransition to the StakeholderRole who authorised it.

properties.label: authorisesRecommendation
properties.description: Links an authorisation activity to the recommendation that was accepted, rejected or overridden.

properties.label: currentState
properties.description: Current service state of the asset — links an Asset to its ServiceState.

properties.label: executesRecommendation
properties.description: Links the action actually executed to the recommendation that motivated it.

properties.label: exposedTo
properties.description: Environmental conditions affecting the asset — links an Asset to OperatingEnvironment.

properties.label: fromState
properties.description: The ServiceState before a transition.

properties.label: governedBy
properties.description: Contract governing the asset — links an Asset to its Contract.

properties.label: hasComponent
properties.description: Asset decomposition hierarchy — links an Asset to its Components.

properties.label: hasDegradationMechanism
properties.description: Physical degradation mechanism of a component.

properties.label: hasDocument
properties.description: Links an entity (Asset, Component, MaintenanceProcess) to its associated SupportingDocument(s).

properties.label: hasFailureMode
properties.description: Identified failure modes of a component.

properties.label: hasKPI
properties.description: KPIs defined by the contract.

properties.label: hasObligation
properties.description: Obligations imposed by the contract.

properties.label: hasPenaltyClause
properties.description: Penalty for KPI underperformance.

properties.label: hasPostActionObservation
properties.description: Links an executed action to observations collected after completion.

properties.label: hasRUL
properties.description: Latest RUL prediction for a component.

properties.label: hasSubComponent
properties.description: Sub-component nesting (recursive) — links a Component to a sub-Component.

properties.label: informsNextDecision
properties.description: Links an intervention outcome assessment to the next ServiceStateTransition or decision event it informs.

properties.label: isSpareFor
properties.description: Which component type this spare part replaces.

properties.label: kpiAtRiskOf
properties.description: Links a ContractKPI to the FailureMode that puts it at risk.

properties.label: monitoredBy
properties.description: Sensor deployment on a component — links a Component to the Sensor(s) monitoring it.

properties.label: monitors
properties.description: Inverse of monitoredBy — links a Sensor to the Component it monitors.

properties.label: offersService
properties.description: Service catalogue linkage — links a ServiceOffering to the ServiceProcess it delivers.

properties.label: operatedAt
properties.description: Deployment site of the asset — links an Asset to its OperatingSite.

properties.label: performedAt
properties.description: Where maintenance is performed — links a ServiceProcess to a ServiceCenter.

properties.label: performedBy
properties.description: Who performs the service action — links a ServiceProcess to a StakeholderRole.

properties.label: producesFeedbackUpdate
properties.description: Links an intervention outcome assessment to its model, threshold or policy feedback record.

properties.label: realisesFailureMode
properties.description: Failure mode manifested by a condition event.

properties.label: recommendsAction
properties.description: Links an advisory recommendation to the proposed service process or action type.

properties.label: requiresConsumable
properties.description: Consumable needed for maintenance.

properties.label: requiresSparePart
properties.description: Spare part needed for maintenance.

properties.label: satisfiesKPI
properties.description: Service contributes to KPI fulfilment.

properties.label: settledBy
properties.description: Settlement record for a billing period.

properties.label: storedAt
properties.description: Inventory location of the spare part.

properties.label: toState
properties.description: The ServiceState after a transition.

properties.label: triggeredBy
properties.description: The ConditionEvent that triggered a ServiceStateTransition.

properties.label: ambientTempC
properties.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius.

properties.label: assessedAt
properties.description: Timestamp at which the intervention outcome was assessed.

properties.label: billingPeriod
properties.description: Billing period (e.g., monthly, quarterly).

properties.label: contractEndDate
properties.description: Contract end date.

properties.label: contractStartDate
properties.description: Contract start date.

properties.label: crackLength_mm
properties.description: Ground-truth or estimated crack length in millimetres.

properties.label: documentDate
properties.description: Date the supporting document was issued or recorded.

properties.label: documentType
properties.description: Category label for the document (e.g., 'Inspection Report', 'Work Order', 'Compliance Certificate').

properties.label: emittedAt
properties.description: Timestamp of RUL emission.

properties.label: executionStatus
properties.description: Completion status of an ActionExecution, for example completed, partial, deferred or failed.

properties.label: healthScore
properties.description: Normalised health score in range [0, 1].

properties.label: meanRULhours
properties.description: Mean predicted remaining useful life in hours.

properties.label: outcomeStatus
properties.description: Assessment of whether the intervention effect was confirmed, partially confirmed, not confirmed or inconclusive.

properties.label: p10RULhours
properties.description: 10th percentile RUL in hours (risk-averse estimate).

properties.label: p50RULhours
properties.description: Median (50th percentile) RUL estimate in hours.

properties.label: p90RULhours
properties.description: 90th percentile RUL in hours (optimistic estimate).

properties.label: penaltyRateUSD
properties.description: Penalty per unit shortfall in USD.

properties.label: recommendationStatus
properties.description: Lifecycle status of a recommendation, for example proposed, accepted, rejected or overridden.

properties.label: settlementDate
properties.description: Date of settlement computation.

properties.label: settlementValue
properties.description: Settlement amount for the billing period.

properties.label: severityClass
properties.description: Severity classification label (e.g., C0-C6).

properties.label: stateLabel
properties.description: State name: one of {Nominal, Watch, Degraded, MaintenanceDue, OutOfContract}.

properties.label: targetValue
properties.description: Contractual target value for the KPI.

properties.label: threshold
properties.description: Contractual threshold value for the KPI.

properties.label: transitionTime
properties.description: Timestamp when the service-state transition occurred.

properties.label: windSpeedMS
properties.description: Wind speed in metres per second.
